test_title: PYST 27: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven friends, A, B, C, D, N, O and P, are sitting in a straight row facing north. No one sits to the right of A. Only three people sit between A and D. Only two people sit between D and B. C sits third to the left of P. N sits to the immediate right of P. How many people sit between O and B?
solution:
Given:

Seven friends, A, B, C, D, N, O and P, are sitting in a straight row facing north.

No one sits to the right of A. Only three people sit between A and D.

Only two people sit between D and B.

C sits third to the left of P. N sits to the immediate right of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c394bdb0f9defe4c4555e7039d13f1501c0fc83e0bd8431e1570c6fe4c13e6a1.png] 

Thus, 3 people sit between O and B.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
